quarterly_data.quarter: Honeywell Aerospace press release: HONA Investor Horizons: Supply Chain Frequently Asked (09-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Honeywell Aerospace investor note (September 2026) on supply chain: this year it is accelerating strategic capital investments with more than a $50 million increase from the prior year for supplier tooling, multi-sourcing and insourcing, and as an independent company is looking to pull forward additional investments into 2027; new sources coming online and skilled employees placed at suppliers have begun to produce early indicators of increasing output in recent weeks. Near term it expects volume leverage from the supply chain unlock to more than offset the incremental investments on an annual basis, though incremental margins over the next couple of years may be lighter than the ~30% average implied from 2025 to 2030 by its Investor Day targets. While supply is limited it allocates more to commercial OE and domestic defense and less to commercial spares and international defense; its products are primarily sole-sourced into the platforms it supports, so constrained output defers sales to a future period. GE is a longstanding customer for engine controls in its Control Systems segment.
quarterly_data.figure: more than a $50 million increase in strategic capital investments; ~30% average incremental margin implied 2025 to 2030
